items.label: [One-Press Power Outlets]
items.value: SNTD' kitchen storage rack has 3 power outlets and an air switch—it's your socket butler for coffee maker, toaster, and blender. One flip powers all three appliances—no more bending to yank plugs or taming cords. Like a trusty sidekick, it lets you tune into bacon sizzle and coffee hum while savoring a stress-free breakfast

items.label: [Assemble & Enjoy]
items.value: This bakers rack makes assembly a breeze. Parts are symbol-marked for easy ID, paired with a detailed manual and installation video tutorials. Even first-timers can set it up fast. It turns assembly from a chore into a win, freeing you to enjoy your organized space faster

items.label: [Large Divided Storage]
items.value: Freeing up kitchen counter and cabinet space, this microwave stand features 10 wooden shelves, neatly accommodating appliances, cookware, spices, etc. A pull-out basket ensures fruits and veggies stay ventilated and accessible, while 14 hooks keep mugs and utensils within arm's reach while baking

items.label: [3 Shields, NO Tip]
items.value: Worried about the shelf tipping over with kids around? Our coffee bar is equipped with three safeguards: anti-tip devices to protect your family, an X-shaped bracket to reinforce the structure and prevent collapse, and adjustable feet to level on uneven floors. Organize with peace of mind—it brings sturdiness and safety to your kitchen

items.label: [Built to Last]
items.value: Crafted from heavy-duty metal (thickness: 15mm) with an anti-rust coating and premium wooden panels (thickness: 12mm), this kitchen shelf organizer balances durability and aesthetics, offering a total load-bearing capacity of 366 pounds—easily accommodating large kitchen appliances while providing long-lasting support for kitchen organization

items.label: [Premium Wooden Panels]
items.value: With scratch-resistant panels built to withstand daily use and a waterproof coating enabling effortless wipe-up of spills, these shelves are perfect for kitchen—simply use a cloth to remove stain and dust, ensuring easy maintenance and long-lasting tidiness

items.label: [All-in-One Storage Shelf]
items.value: Be it a coffee bar station, plant stand, or book shelf, this kitchen shelf organizer rack can meet all. Its sleek lines and premium texture blend effortlessly with home decor. This harmony of practical storage and spatial elegance achieves a perfect balance between function and design
